# command: add books as the same as obsidian

Add a `books` shortcut into Apple Books' storage, in the style of `obsidian` ([#269](DOT-268.md)). **Motivation:** "review disk usage, now I have 27G audiobooks":

```bash
$ books
# cd ~/Library/Containers/com.apple.BKAgentService/Data/Documents/iBooks
# du -h * | sort -h
```

<!-- 2026-09-16T05:49Z https://github.com/kamilsk/dotfiles/issues/618#issuecomment-5711708590
Code vs intent: `books` depends on `gum choose`, but `gum` is not declared in any host Brewfile (candidates only), and `self-update brew` runs `brew bundle --force-cleanup`, which uninstalls undeclared formulae — so after an update the command fails with `command not found: gum`. See the note on #556.
-->
